core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nashat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Activity, liveliness, energy”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nashat corresponds to the Arabic form نَشَاط (Arabic root ن ش ط (n-sh-ṭ); نَشَاط (Nashāṭ)). Its core sense is activity, liveliness, energy. Nashat is Arabic نَشَاط (Nashāṭ) 'activity, liveliness, energy', from the root ن ش ط (n-sh-ṭ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نشت (a different form); the correct form is نَشَاط. The source gloss 'Restraint, Prevention' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nashaat.

persian.name: نشاط
